_comment: The family business: Echo Core offspring inherit Spark and heirloom arts from the two singers (scripts/core/Breeding.gd). The matchmaker at the Rest Spring seals a match contract on a carried core for a fee: more Spark and arts are passed on. Sometimes she sold the same match twice (betray_chance); then only the contract bonus is lost, the young Spirling still wakes with the plain inheritance.
rival_families: a family she calls 'the other one'
contract_lines: Auntie Grisela: A good match is a merger with feathers.
Auntie Grisela: I put the dowry in writing. Nobody reads it, but it is written.
honoured_line: Auntie Grisela's contract holds. The young one carries the best of both houses.
betrayed_line: Turns out Auntie Grisela sold the same match to %s. The contract is void, but the song still wakes.
